title: Sycophancy-on-Verifiable-Math: BrokenMath-Style Probe for Open Models

original_idea.body: Sycophancy-on-Verifiable-Math. Problem: no compact probe applies false-premise agreement tests on grade-school/competition math for open models. Direction: inject subtly false premises into correct math problems as user-stated, measure how often the model agrees vs corrects; report a domain-specific sycophancy rate.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (verifiable sycophancy measurement) but catastrophic-risk link is a skipped step.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Public math data, false-premise injection, prompting only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single probe with clean ground-truth metric.

novelty.reasoning: BrokenMath already benchmarks math sycophancy; this is largely a lighter open-model port.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: BrokenMath benchmarks false-premise math sycophancy; a compact open-model version is incremental.
